newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open mostly lower.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures were called to open mostly lower Tuesday as gold remained soft overnight in the face of a firm dollar and platinum group metals eased further after confirmation that Russia would resume exports in late June.
COMEX August gold was called unchanged to off $0.50 cents from Monday's close of $344.80 an ounce after trading from $344.80 to $343.60 on ACCESS.
In the bullion market, spot gold was quoted at $341.40/70 early against the London morning fix of $341.40.
